text: For the leader. A psalm of David.
I O God, hear my anguished voice;from a dreadful foe protect my life.
Hide me from the malicious crowd,the mob of evildoers.
They sharpen their tongues like swords,bend their bows of poison words. [AA]
They shoot at the innocent from ambush,they shoot him in a moment and do not fear.
They resolve on their wicked plan;they conspire to set snares;they say: "Who will see us?"
They devise wicked schemes,conceal the schemes they devise;the designs of their hearts are hidden. [AB]
II God shoots an arrow at them;in a moment they are struck down. [AC]
They are brought down by their own tongues;all who see them flee. [AD]
Every person fears and proclaims God's actions,they ponder his deeds.
The righteous rejoices and takes refuge in the Lord;all the upright give praise. [AE]
